Application Requirements
As part of your online application, you will provide:
$50 application fee
Names and contact information of three people who will write letters of recommendation
Resume/CV
Official copies of your transcripts
Official copies of recent TOEFL scores if your native language is not English (International Students only)
A statement about the area of biology or botany in which you intend to specialize and your career objectives.
Applicants to the Biology and Botany Graduate Programs
Applicants must have all forms (including those required by the Graduate School) no later than January 1st.
Applications will be accepted after January 1st; however, late applications may not receive full consideration.
All applications are considered for fall admission.
Students are strongly advised to personally contact potential faculty advisors before January 1st. Applicants without a faculty sponsor will not be considered for admission to the Biology or Botany Graduate Programs.
